parameters.query: with j as (select * from app.job_start($1::uuid)) select j.id as job_id, j.input, j.attempts, j.max_attempts from j
with f as (select * from app.job_finish($1::uuid, $2, $3::jsonb, $4, $5::boolean)) select f.id, f.status, f.attempts, app.record_job_steps($1::uuid, $6, $7, $8::jsonb) as execution_id from f
